n-k-k10-04.title: Ziviso imwe, vavakidzani vaviri
n-k-k10-04.topic: Kupfupisa ziviso yakarurama pasina kurasa miganhu yayo
n-k-k10-04.goal: Tsvaga mutsara wechipfupiso unoshandura muganhu wenguva weziviso, wobva wanyora patsva ziviso yeboka revavakidzani nekuyeuchidza kunotaurwa kumuvakidzani akura, uchichengeta zuva, maawa nechivako zvakarurama.
n-k-k10-04.material:
Ofisi yekuronga yakaisa ziviso. Unogara mu 101동.

[단수 안내]
배관 점검 공사로 10월 25일 토요일 오전 9시부터 오후 2시까지 101동 전 세대의 물이 나오지 않습니다. 공사가 일찍 끝나면 물이 먼저 나올 수 있습니다. 단수 전에 필요한 물을 미리 받아 두시기 바라며, 공사 후 처음 나오는 물은 누런색일 수 있으니 잠시 틀어 둔 뒤 사용하시기 바랍니다.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.prompt: Muvakidzani akagadzira zvipfupiso zvina zvipfupi zveziviso. Chipi chinoshandura revo?
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga zvakare ziviso uye unyore zvokwadi zvayo (rinhi, kupi, zvekuita). Wobva waenzanisa chipfupiso chimwe nechimwe nerondedzero yako.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga chirevo chipi nechipi chinoita kuti nguva ive yakareba, pfupi kana isina kunyatsoita kupfuura zvinotaurwa neziviso.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.r.a: Izvi zvinochengeta zuva, maawa nechivako sezvazvakaita muziviso.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.r.b: Ziviso inoti mvura inogona kudzoka nekukurumidza kana basa rikapera nekukurumidza.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.r.c: Ziviso inoti mvura yekutanga shure kwebasa inogona kuva yero uye inofanira kuyerwa kwenguva.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.explain: '하루 종일' inowedzera kuvharwa kwemaawa mashanu (9:00-14:00) kusvika pazuva rose, izvo zvaizoita kuti vanhu varonge zvisina kururama.
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.prompt: Nyora meseji pfupi (mitsara 2-3) yeboka revavakidzani muchiKorea, 해요체 inofadza. Chengeta zuva, maawa, chivako nezano nezvemvura zvakarurama.
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora zvokwadi zvina zvinofanira kuramba zvakachengetwa: rinhi, kusvika rinhi, ndiani anokanganiswa, chekuita kutanga.
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.hint.1: Taura patsva chimwe nechimwe mu 해요체 inofadza uye utsive mazwi akaoma eziviso nemazwi ekutaura.
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Muvakidzani anoverenga meseji yangu oga angaziva zvakanaka kuti mvura inomira rinhi uye kupi here?
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Inonzwika semutauro wevavakidzani here, kwete seziviso?
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.prompt: Unosangana nemuvakidzani akura paelevator. Taura pfungwa huru mumitsara mumwe kana miviri yakataurwa muchiKorea, nerukudzo (honorific). Chengeta zuva, maawa nezano.
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga nekuregerera muvakidzani nerukudzo (어르신, 할머니, 할아버지 ...).
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.hint.1: Shandisa -(으)세요 kana -(으)시- pane zvinofanira kuitwa nemuvakidzani, uye chengeta maawa mapfupi.
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndaizotaura zvakadaro kumunhu akura wandinoremekedza here?
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Muvakidzani anogona kuita zvaanonzi (zuva, maawa, kugadzirira mvura) kubva pane izvi oga here?

n-k-k10-01.title: Ndiani akazvitaura, uye zvakasimba sei?
n-k-k10-01.goal: Enzanisa mupfupiso wemudzidzi nerekodhi rekutanga rechiteero, tsvaga mitsara inotaura zvisina kururama pamusoro pemutauri, taura rudzi rwekuchinja, uye nyora zvakare mutsara mumwe usina kuchinjwa.
n-k-k10-01.material:
Mudzidzi wepepanhau rechikoro akapfupisa chiteero chevose. Pazasi pane mazwi chaiwo evatauri wobva wauya mupfupiso wemudzidzi.

[간담회 발언 기록] 주제: 전통시장 주차장 유료화
박 시장: "내년 3월부터 시범 운영을 검토하고 있습니다. 아직 확정된 것은 아닙니다."
김 상인회장: "유료화되면 손님이 줄어들까 걱정입니다. 첫 30분은 무료로 해 주셨으면 합니다."
이 교수: "다른 도시에서는 유료화 후 주차 회전율이 높아졌다는 연구가 있습니다. 다만 상인 매출에 미친 영향은 도시마다 달랐습니다."
n-k-k10-01.thinking.1: Kucherekedza shanduko mukuti chirevo chinotaurwa nesimba rakadii
n-k-k10-01.prereq.1: Unoziva reported speech (-다고 했다) ne -(으)ㄹ까 걱정이다
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.prompt: Mitsara miviri yemupfupiso wemudzidzi haienderani nezvakataurwa nemutauri akatumidzwa. Sarudza imwe yadzo (chero imwe inoverengwa).
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tora mutsara mumwe nomumwe nenzira uye utsvage munhu anotaurwa mukati merekodhi.
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa chirevo chiri mumutsara nemitsara yemunhu iyeyo: ndicho chirevo chimwechete, chakataurwa nemunhu mumwechete here?
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.hint.2: Kana mutsara uchiita sokuenderana, uuise padivi pemutsara werekodhi wawakabva uye uuenzanise izwi neizwi.
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 2 unochinja kunetseka kwemukuru wevatengesi ('줄어들까 걱정입니다') kuita chirevo chakasimba ('단언했다'). Mutsara 5 unopa chirevo chemuprofesa pamusoro pekutsvaga kumeya. Mitsara 1, 3, 4 ne6 inoenderana nerekodhi.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.prompt: Mitsara miviri ine mhosva. Tsananguro mbiri dzipi dzinokodzera zvakaitika zvisina kururama mairi?
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tsanangura dambudziko remutsara une mhosva wega wega mugwaro rimwe usati watarisa sarudzo.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza kuti sarudzo imwe neimwe inoitika mumutsara waunosarudza kana pasina.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.r.b: Mitsara yose miviri ine mhosva inochengeta nhamba (3월, 30분) sezvazvakange zvakaita; kukanganisa kuri kumwe.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.r.d: Chikumbiro chemaminetsi 30 emahara chinotaurwa sechikumbiro ('요청했다') mumutsara 3, izvo zvakarurama.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.explain: Mutsara mumwe unopa chirevo chemuprofesa chekutsvaga kumeya; mumwe unokwidziridza '걱정입니다' kuita mhedzisiro yakasimba.
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.prompt: Nyora zvakare mutsara une mhosva wezve 상인회장 kuti utaure mazwi ake pasina kuchinja. Nyora muKorean (mhando yenhau, semuenzaniso -다고 말했다) kana muChirungu.
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga mutsara nemunhu anotaurwa nerekodhi, wobva wataura zvaanonzwa kana zvaakakumbira.
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.hint.1: Sarudza verb kana mugumo unoenderana ne 'I am worried that...' kwete 'it will happen'.
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Verb kana mugumo wangu unoratidza kunetseka kwete chokwadi here?
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: 상인회장 angaverenga mutsara wangu uye kuti 'yes, that is what I said' here?
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Unoshandisa fomu yekugona panzvimbo ye 걱정.
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.model.2: The head of the merchants' association said he was worried that fewer customers might come.

n-k-k10-02.title: Nguva dzekudzidzira dzipi dzinoramba dzichiita mitemo yose?
n-k-k10-02.topic: Chiziviso chine chikamu chechisingaverengwi: kutsvaga sarudzo dzose dzakarurama
n-k-k10-02.goal: Verenga chiziviso cheimba yekirabhu chine mutemo wenguva yekupedzisira, kuzorora kwemasikati, kuvhara pakupera kwevhiki nechisingaverengwi chenguva yebvunzo, tsvaga nguva 3 dzekudzidzira pamazuva akasiyana dzinoteerera mitemo yose, uye ukumbire imwe muKorean.
n-k-k10-02.material:
Nhasi ndi10월 10일, 월요일. Bhendi yako inoda kubhuka imba yekirabhu nhasi.

[동아리방 사용 안내]
1. 사용 신청은 사용일 3일 전까지 받습니다.
2. 사용 시간은 오전 10시부터 오후 8시까지이며, 한 팀이 한 번에 쓸 수 있는 시간은 3시간 이내입니다.
3. 낮 12시부터 오후 1시까지는 점심시간이므로 사용할 수 없습니다.
4. 토요일과 일요일에는 문을 열지 않습니다.
5. 단, 시험 기간인 10월 17일부터 19일까지는 사용할 수 없습니다.

밴드 친구의 문자: "우리 공연이 22일이라 21일까지는 연습을 끝내야 해요. 연습은 한 번에 2시간 이상 해야 하고요."
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.prompt: Mamiriro 1 anoti zvikumbiro zvinopera mazuva matatu zuva rekushandisa risati rasvika. Kana ukakumbira nhasi (pa10), mazuva ekushandisa api anobvumirwa?
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.hint.0: Bvunza: pazuva rekushandisa ripi 'nhasi' ndiwo mazuva matatu chaiwo kare?
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.hint.1: Fungidzira kuti zuva rakazotevera rinoita kuti chikumbiro chive chekare kana gare gare pane nguva yekupedzisira.
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.r.b: Izvo zvinodzosera nzira shure: mutemo unoisa zuva rekutanga raunogona kubhuka, kwete rekupedzisira.
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.r.c: '-까지' inopa muganhu, kwete zuva rimwe chaiwo; mazuva akazotevera anobvumirwawo.
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.r.d: Izvo zvinoverenga mazuva matatu shure kubva nhasi, asi mutemo unoverenga kubva pazuva rekushandisa.
n-k-k10-02.s.s1.explain: Kukumbira pa10 ndiwo mazuva matatu chaiwo kare pa13, saka 13 ndiro zuva rekutanga rekushandisa uye mazuva akazotevera anoshandawo.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga nguva 3 dzekudzidzira pamazuva 3 akasiyana dzinoteerera chiziviso nemameseji eshamwari yebhendi. d = zuva muna October, s = awa rekutanga pawachi ye 24-hour (오후 2시 = 14), t = maawa ekudzidzira.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora kalendari kubva pa10: zuva rimwe nerimwe revhiki ndezuva ripi? Pa10 ndi Monday.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.hint.1: Pfuura nemazuva kutanga (ekare kwazvo, enguva yakareba, kupera kwevhiki, chisingaverengwi), wobva wasarudza maawa.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.hint.2: Tarisa wachi pakupedzisira: tanga pa10 kana gare gare, pedza pa20, chengeta 12-13 isina chinhu, uye ureba maawa 2-3.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Rakadaro kare zvakanyanya: nguva yekupedzisira yechikumbiro ndimazuva 3 zuva rekushandisa risati rasvika.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Imba yekirabhu yakavharwa pazuva iroro (kupera kwevhiki).
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.fail.c5: Nguva inotanga nokukurumidza kana kupera mushure mekuvhara.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.fail.c6: Kudzidzira kunofanira kuva maawa 2 kana kupfuura uye kirabhu inobvumira 3 pamusoro.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.explain: Mazuva mana chete ndiwo anoshanda: 13 ne14 (Thu, Fri) ne20 ne21 (Thu, Fri). 15-16 ndekupera kwevhiki, 17-19 inguva yebvunzo (chisingaverengwi), 12 yakare kwazvo, uye 22 yakareba kwazvo. Pazuva rimwe nerimwe maawa anofanira kudzivisa masikati uye agare mukati me10:00-20:00.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza IMWE yenguva dzako uye unyore meseji pfupi muKorean (ine hunhu) kumutariri weimba yekirabhu uchikumbira iyo. Taura zuva nenguva.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tanga nekwaziso kana zuva, wobva wataura nguva.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Pedzisa nechikumbiro chine hunhu senge -고 싶습니다 kana 신청합니다.
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Zuva nenguva zvinoenderana nenguva yandakavaka here?
n-k-k10-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Meseji ine hunhu hwakakwana kumutariri here?

n-k-k10-03.title: Shopu inogona kurambira kudzorera mari iyi here?
n-k-k10-03.topic: Mitemo ine chisingaverengwi: chokwadi chipi chinosarudza nyaya
n-k-k10-03.goal: Tsvaga chokwadi chimwe chinoshaikwa chinosarudza chikumbiro chekudzorerwa mari pasi pemutemo une chisingaverengwi, taura zvinogona kutaurwa nokukurumidza, uye ukumbire chokwadi chinoshaikwa nehunhu muKorean.
n-k-k10-03.material:
Mitemo yekudzorera mari yeshopu nechikumbiro chemutengi.

[환불 안내]
1. 구매일로부터 7일 이내에 신청하시면 환불해 드립니다.
2. 포장을 뜯었거나 사용한 상품은 환불이 되지 않습니다.
3. 단, 상품에 불량이 있는 경우에는 구매일로부터 30일 이내에 포장이나 사용 여부와 상관없이 환불해 드립니다.

[주문 내역] 무선 이어폰 1개 / 구매일: 10월 3일
오늘은 10월 12일입니다. 손님: "이어폰이 생각보다 별로예요. 환불해 주세요."
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.prompt: Uri mushandi weshopu. Chokwadi chipi CHIMWE chinoshaikwa chaizochinja kuti kudzorerwa kwemari kunogoneka here?
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wakaverenga mazuva mangani apfuura kubva pakutengwa uye wakaenzanisa nemutemo wekutanga.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.hint.1: Wobva watsvaga mutemo waungabatsira mutengi uye uone zvainoda.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.o.a: Kuti mutengi akabhadhara nekadhi here kana mari.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.a: Mitemo haitauri kuti mutengi akabhadhara sei.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.o.b: Kuti maearphones achiri akavharwa mupaketi here.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.b: Muganhu wemazuva 7 wapfuura kare, saka paketi yakavharwa yoga haiwanise mari yakadzoserwa, uye mutemo 3 hauteereri paketi zvakadaro.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.d: Rekodhi yeodha inoratidza kare zuva rekutenga, uye mitemo haikumbire resiti.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.explain: Kuverenga kubva pa 10월 3일, nhasi izuva rechi9, saka mutemo 1 hauchashandi. Mutemo 3 chete ndiwo ungapa mari yakadzoserwa, uye unoenderana nekuti pane kukanganisa here.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.prompt: Zvichienderana nezvinozivikanwa ikozvino chete, mushandi anogona kutaura chii zvakarurama?
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.hint.0: Patsanura zvinosarudzwa kare nezvokwadi kubva kune zvinosiiwa zvakavhurika.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa sarudzo imwe neimwe kuti iwedzera chokwadi chisina kutaurwa munyaya here, kana kusiya mutemo.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.a: Mari yakadzoserwa inogoneka, nokuti chikumbiro chiri mukati memazuva 7.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.b: Mari yakadzoserwa yekuchinja pfungwa yapfuura muganhu, asi chigadzirwa chine kukanganisa chichiri kukodzera.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.c: Mari yakadzoserwa haigoneki chero mamiriro api, nokuti mazuva 7 apfuura.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.c: Izvi hazvitarisi mutemo 3, unopa mazuva 30 kana pane kukanganisa.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.d: Mari yakadzoserwa inogoneka kana paketi isati yavhurwa chete.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.d: Paketi isina kuvhurwa inokosha mukati memazuva 7 chete; shure kwaizvozvo, hapana chiri mumitemo chinopa mari yakadzoserwa kuchigadzirwa chisina kuvhurwa.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.e: Mari yakadzoserwa haigoneki, nokuti pamwe paketi yakavhurwa.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.e: Hapana chiri munyaya chinoti paketi yakavhurwa; uku kufungidzira.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.explain: Mushandi anogona kutaura zvinotevera kubva pazvokwadi: hapana mari yakadzoserwa yekungoramba chigadzirwa shure kwemazuva 7, asi mhinduro inogona kuchinja kana chigadzirwa chine kukanganisa.
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.prompt: Pindura mutengi muchiKorea (nerukudzo). Taura kuti muganhu wemazuva 7 wapfuura wemari yakadzoserwa yekuchinja pfungwa, wobva wabvunza chinhu chimwe chaunoda kuziva usati wasarudza.
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga nekupa chikonzero kubva pamutemo wekutanga, nekupfupisa uye nerukudzo.
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.hint.1: Wobva waverenga zvakare mitemo mitatu uye ubvunze nezvechokwadi chichiri kushayiwa munyaya.
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndinotsanangura here kuti nei mhinduro isati iri hongu?
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Mubvunzo wangu unobvunza chokwadi chimwe chinosarudza nyaya here?
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Mutauro wangu une rukudzo kumutengi here?

n-k-k10-05.title: 'Hongu' yaireva kuti aiwa
n-k-k10-05.topic: Kupindura mubvunzo wakaramba: 네 ne 아니요
n-k-k10-05.goal: Gadzirisa kuverenga kwako kwe 네 yoga shure kwemubvunzo wakaramba sezvinoratidzwa nedhayarogu kuti pane kusanzwisisana, sarudza nzira yakajeka yekupindura, uye gadzirisa kusanzwisisana muchiKorea.
n-k-k10-05.material: Unoshanda mukambani. Musoro wedhipatimendi (부장님) anokubvunza nezvemusangano wemangwana. Imi mose muri kutaura nerukudzo.
n-k-k10-05.thinking.0: Kucherekedza kuti mhinduro pfupi inogona kuverengwa nenzira mbiri
n-k-k10-05.thinking.1: Kugadzirisa kuverenga kana kuita kwomumwe kwaonekwa
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.prompt: Verenga chikamu chimwe nechimwe uye usarudze kuverenga kunoita sekwakanyanya usati waenderera.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza uchishandisa mitsara yawaverenga kusvika zvino chete.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.hint.1: Fungira kuti mutauri aibvuma nei: mubvunzo sezvawakabvunzwa, kana zvokwadi?
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Muchiko chakajairika, 네 yoga inobvuma mubvunzo sezvawakabvunzwa ('네, 안 가요'), saka a ndiko kuverenga kwakajairika. Kuverenga b ndiko kunoreva kwemutauri akajaira 'yes' yechiRungu. Mumwe kana mumwe, 네 yoga haiudzi muteereri kuti ndeipi.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: 네 yoga haipi chiratidzo chekudzikama; mhinduro isina kusarudzwa yaizoshandisa mazwi senge '글쎄요' kana '아직요'.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Hapana chiri mu 네 yakapfava chinobvunza; izwi raizofanira kukwira uye mubvunzo waizoshandisa mazwi.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Zvose a ne d zvinogona kukodzera, asi 아니요 yakananga ya나 nekusimbisa zvinoratidza a: 네 yoga yakanzwika se 'handiende' kunyange 나 aireva 'hongu, ndiri kuenda'.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 부장님 akanzwa 네 se 'handiende'; 나 aireva 'hongu, ndiri kuenda'.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 부장님 akanzwa 네 se 'ndiri kuenda', uye 나 haaendi chaizvo.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Mutsara wekupedzisira wa나 unoti 가요 ne 갈 거예요, saka 나 ari kuenda.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: 부장님 ne 나 havabvumirani nezvezuva remusangano.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.o.d: 나 akachinja pfungwa shure kwekunge 부장님 ataura kwaari.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Nguva inotevera kana mubvunzo wakaramba wauya, nzira ipi yekupindura inodzivirira dambudziko iri?
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Kudzokorora chiito nekuramba kwacho kana kubvuma kunotaura chokwadi zvakananga, saka muteereri haafanire kusarudza kuti 네 inonongedzera kudii.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Pindura 네 uye utsanangure shure chete kana muteereri achiita sakavhiringika.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kusanzwisisana kunoitika kare pa 네 yekutanga; kutsanangura shure kunogadzirisa panzvimbo yekudzivirira.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Pindura ne 네 inonzwika zvakanyanya uye yakajeka.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kunzwika zvakanyanya hakuchinji chokwadi chekuti 네 inogona kunzwikwa sekubvuma mubvunzo kana zvokwadi.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Nguva dzose pindura 아니요, chero mubvunzo upi.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kugara uchiti 아니요 kwaizopa mhinduro isina kururama panguva dzose mhinduro chaiyo iri yekuti hauendi.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Taura 네 kana 아니요 uye udzokorore chiito: '네, 안 가요' kana '아니요, 가요'.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.reflect: 네 kana 아니요 yoga shure kwemubvunzo wakaramba ('안 가세요?') inobatana nemubvunzo wose, kwete zvokwadi chete, saka inogona kunzwikwa nenzira mbiri dzinopesana. Kuwedzera chiito ('아니요, 가요') kunodzivirira kusanzwisisana.
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.prompt: Pakarepo shure kwekusanzwisisana, unotumira 부장님 meseji pfupi muchiKorea (nerukudzo) uchiti waireva kuti UNOENDA uye uchikumbira ruregerero nekuvhiringidzika.
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.hint.0: Taura 부장님 uye uti ndine ushungu nekuvhiringidzika nemashoko mapfupi.
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.hint.1: Taura chokwadi nechiito (zvauchaita mangwana), kwete neizwi rimwe chete rekupindura.
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Meseji yangu inoti zvakajeka kuti ndiri kuenda here?
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ndinotaura chokwadi nechiito panzvimbo ye 네 yoga here?
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Kukumbira ruregerero kwangu kune rukudzo asi kusina kureba zvakanyanya here?
